remarks: Welcome to Vista Tower, one of Stamford's premier high-rise residences. This well-maintained 8th-floor unit offers 1,336 square feet of stylish and comfortable living space with sweeping southern exposure, filling the home with natural sunlight throughout the day.The modern kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, a tasteful tile backsplash, and a stainless steel refrigerator, combining both function and style for the home chef.With two spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, this unit provides plenty of room for living, working, and relaxing.Enjoy vibrant city views, a prime downtown location, and the convenience of high-rise living. Close to Stamford's top restaurants, shopping, Metro-North, and I-95 - everything you need is just moments away.
